title: Personal trainer in Ubud: travel, access and outer-zone rates
description: Ubud personal training is Rp 900.000 plus Rp 150.000 travel per visit. Valley access, indoor floors and how the quote is built.

faqs.q: Is Ubud in-zone?
faqs.a: No. Ubud adds Rp 150.000 travel per visit on top of the Bali session rate.

faqs.q: Is the valley view the venue?
faqs.a: No. The hour needs a level indoor floor and a realistic walk from the road.

faqs.q: Does travel apply once for a whole stay?
faqs.a: No. Travel is per visit. A six-session Ubud block includes travel six times.

title: 60 or 90 minutes: how home session duration is quoted
description: Ninety minutes add 45 percent of the city base, before travel. When to extend a home session and when to buy two hours.

faqs.q: How much is 90 minutes?
faqs.a: It adds 45 percent of the city base rate, before extra people and travel.

faqs.q: Does 90 minutes include two services?
faqs.a: No. One session stays one session. Two services are two quotes.

faqs.q: Should a first visit be 90 minutes?
faqs.a: Usually no. A first visit is 60 minutes unless the floor, window and goal already justify the extension.

title: How villa managers book guest fitness sessions
description: One coordinator, a named session and a written quote. How hosts book training, yoga, Pilates, boxing or meditation for guests.
primaryQuery: villa manager book personal trainer Bali

faqs.q: Can a villa book without the guest on the thread?
faqs.a: Yes. One property contact is better. The guest can still receive the confirmation.

faqs.q: Is a wedding week an automatic surcharge?
faqs.a: No. It is a diary problem. Send the dates and wait for a written yes, a second window, or a decline.

faqs.q: Can the trainer also treat a guest shoulder?
faqs.a: No. Live hours stay fitness. Physiotherapy and nutrition stay held.

title: Personal trainer in South Jakarta: Kemang, Senopati and lobby access
description: South Jakarta personal training from Rp 950.000. Kemang houses, Senopati towers and the lobby rules that decide the hour.

faqs.q: Is South Jakarta in-zone?
faqs.a: Yes for published clusters such as Kemang, Senopati, SCBD and Cilandak. The building still goes on the quote.

faqs.q: Do I need a home gym?
faqs.a: No. A clear living-room rectangle and an access plan are enough for the first hour.

faqs.q: Is BSD the same rate?
faqs.a: No. BSD and outer municipalities are quoted after a timing check, or declined.

title: Personal trainer in Uluwatu: Bukit travel and indoor floors
description: Uluwatu personal training is Rp 900.000 plus Rp 200.000 travel per visit. Bingin, Pecatu, indoor floors and what we will not sell on a cliff.

faqs.q: Is Uluwatu in-zone?
faqs.a: No. Uluwatu, Pecatu and Bingin add Rp 200.000 travel per visit.

faqs.q: Can we train on the cliff?
faqs.a: No. The hour needs a dry indoor floor. A cliff caption is not a venue.

faqs.q: Does travel apply once for the stay?
faqs.a: No. Travel is per visit, including on a six-session block.

title: What a written quote includes before you pay
description: The written quote is the contract for the visit: service, people, cluster, total, exclusions and the 24-hour rule. A website number is only a start.
primaryQuery: what does a personal trainer quote include

faqs.q: Is the website price the payable total?
faqs.a: No. It is the starting price. The written quote is the payable total.

faqs.q: Can I pay in WhatsApp?
faqs.a: No. Pay only on the merchant link in the quote.

faqs.q: What if the quote is wrong?
faqs.a: Reply in the same thread before payment. Name the field that changed.

title: Boxing fitness in a Jakarta apartment: pads, noise and one person
description: Jakarta boxing fitness from Rp 1.050.000 is pad-only, one person, after a ceiling and neighbour check. No sparring and no second person in the rate.

faqs.q: Can two people share Jakarta boxing?
faqs.a: Not on the published boxing rate. Quote two hours or pick a session that bills extra people.

faqs.q: Do I need a heavy bag?
faqs.a: No. We bring pads when the session is approved. You need permission and a usable ceiling.

faqs.q: Is evening pad work allowed?
faqs.a: Only if the building allows impact noise. Put the rule on the first message.

title: Private yoga for beginners at home in Bali and Jakarta
description: Beginner private yoga from Rp 850.000 in Bali and Rp 900.000 in Jakarta, with two people included when the floor holds both mats.

faqs.q: Do I need to be experienced?
faqs.a: No. Write beginner in the first message. The hour is still yoga, not therapy.

faqs.q: Are two beginners included?
faqs.a: Yes, in the published yoga rate, if the floor holds both mats.

faqs.q: Do you bring a studio of props?
faqs.a: No. A mat you already have is enough unless the quote says otherwise.
